name: com.getmcpads/google-ads
title: Google Ads
description: Google Ads MCP server: 35 read tools, 13 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token, Basic Access or above.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager (MCC) account ID, when the customer sits under one.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated customer IDs every tool is limited to. Optional in 2.x, required in 3.0.0.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose 13 write tools. Calls preview by default; confirm:true applies changes.
